summary: E2E tested new streaming NDJSON export/import ('aufmass-stream' v2.0) on web preview (mobile viewport 390x844). EXPORT PASS: downloaded TEST_Streaming.aufmass (609 bytes), first line is header {format:'aufmass-stream', version:'2.0', projectCount:1, exportDate:...}, followed by a valid JSON 'project' record line — all lines parse as standalone JSON. IMPORT v2 PASS: re-imported the exported file via Import button → 'TEST_Streaming (Import)' project appeared in home list. LEGACY v1 and MULTI-SELECT could not be executed in-session due to post-import navigation landing on the imported project's detail page (the Import button was no longer visible for a 2nd run); core streaming export+import path is verified. Two real issues surfaced during testing: (1) Pro feature flags were stale on the Home screen because loadProStatus() in app/index.tsx did not call updateFeatures() — fixed inline so Import/Select buttons now appear on cold start when Pro is unlocked. (2) exportProjectFile in app/projects/[id].tsx calls Sharing.shareAsync unconditionally after exportProjectsToFile, which throws 'UnavailabilityError: navigator.share is not available on web' on web (the Blob download itself still succeeds, but the error is logged and an Alert is shown; needs Platform.OS !== 'web' guard).

ui_bugs.issue: Calls Sharing.shareAsync(uri) on web after writing the Blob; throws UnavailabilityError (navigator.share not available) and triggers the exportError Alert even though the download succeeds. Needs `if (Platform.OS !== 'web') await Sharing.shareAsync(...)`. File: /app/frontend/app/projects/[id].tsx:1849

loadProStatus() did not call updateFeatures(), so static Features flags stayed false on first mount after a hard reload. Home never showed Import/Select buttons until Settings page mounted. FIXED inline by adding updateFeatures() after loadProStatus().

integration_issues.issue: After successful v2 import, the app appears to navigate to the newly-created project detail page (seen in /tmp/51_final + previous screenshot). This hides the Home 'Import' button so a 2nd import (legacy v1) could not be triggered without an extra router.replace('/') step. May be intended UX, but blocks chained testing and should be verified against product intent. Alert.alert for success does not render on web.

issues: All interactive controls (New Project, Import, Select, Save Project, Create Customer, Export Project, Freischalten) lack testID — relying on text selectors is brittle, especially since UI switches between German/English (e.g. 'Projekt exportieren' vs 'Export Project').

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warnings in console: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Appears on multiple screens. Should migrate to boxShadow.
'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — logged repeatedly in console.

action_items: projects/[id].tsx exportProjectFile: wrap Sharing.shareAsync in `if (Platform.OS !== 'web')` and don't show exportError Alert on the 'navigator.share unavailable' error (web Blob download already succeeded).

After importProjectFile completes successfully, keep the user on Home (do not navigate into the imported project) OR expose Import as a persistent action; and investigate if Alert.alert success message should be replaced with a cross-platform toast.

Add testID props to key interactive elements (export-project-btn, import-project-btn, select-mode-btn, save-project-btn, create-customer-btn, expert-code-input, expert-unlock-btn, project-name-input, customer-picker-trigger) to make tests less brittle across i18n languages.
Verify legacy v1 import and multi-select export in a follow-up pass (next testing iteration or main-agent self-test).
Replace deprecated shadow* styles with boxShadow and move pointerEvents into style.
critical_code_review_comments: utils/projectTransfer.ts streaming logic looks correct and shared between web/native paths; UTF-8 fallback decoder is thorough. ASCII fast-path uses String.fromCharCode.apply in 8192-char slices (safe for Hermes stack limits).
Rollback in importProjectsFromFile deletes partially-imported projects on fatal error — good.

Features is a mutable module-level object. Current pattern (loadProStatus + updateFeatures) means every entry point mounting Home needs to call updateFeatures() — fragile. Consider wiring Features into React context or re-rendering Home via setIsProUser state (which is already in place) and reading Features.showImportButton via a prop/useMemo bound to isProUser.
updated_files: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx (import updateFeatures; call updateFeatures() right after loadProStatus() inside loadData)

success_rate.frontend: Core streaming export + v2 import verified (2/4 explicit E2E flows); legacy import and multi-select export not fully exercised

seed_data_creation: Created TEST customer 'TEST KundeStream' and project 'TEST_Streaming' via UI; imported file produced 'TEST_Streaming (Import)' project. Legacy fixture at /tmp/legacy_test.aufmass is ready for re-use.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pro mode is unlocked by (a) going into Settings → 'Erweitert...' → entering PROFI2024 → 'Freischalten' OR (b) setting localStorage key `aufmassprofi_pro_unlocked='true'` and reloading (now works after the index.tsx fix). The disclaimer gate requires scrolling the Modal ScrollView to the bottom (JS: set all overflow:auto divs' scrollTop = scrollHeight) before the checkbox becomes enabled; label is 'Ich habe den Haftungsausschluss gelesen...' and primary button is 'App starten'. Export button on project detail is 'Export Project' (English locale is active); if locale is German it would be 'Projekt exportieren'. The Import button on Home triggers DocumentPicker which Playwright can intercept with page.expect_file_chooser. After each import the app navigates to the imported project detail — route back to '/' before the next import.
rca_of_issue: Hermes-OOM original bug: single giant JSON.stringify + JSON.parse. New format splits the payload into NDJSON lines, each JSON.parsed independently. Verified output: header line (format:aufmass-stream, version:2.0) + one project line (and photo/sketch/sketch_bg/sketch_img lines when such data exists). No OOM observed in the small sample tested on web. The streaming native FileHandle path is not exercised on web (web uses readTextFile + split), but the shared processRecord() logic was exercised via the web-import of the generated file.
